scope: The browser now restores a read-only snapshot of reviewed assignments before attempting input discovery when a job exists. These active-job panels and reload behavior were not included in the historical setup recordings. Original recording manifests, media bytes, and captured source hashes are preserved. The exact replacements below reverse only this reviewed UI change before checking the historical PAGE fingerprint. The new methylation-only classifier assignment board is not part of those historical CNA setup recordings. The additional exact replacements reverse that reviewed change before the existing active-job reversal; original media and capture fingerprints remain unchanged. Named-library POD5 preference and explicit-source tracking were added after the older CNA recordings; the prefixed exact inverses restore their previous PAGE. A separate new CpG video records current named-library POD5 behavior directly. The CpG empty-assignment label now explicitly reads Unknown / do not classify and distinguishes classifier choice from clinical Cancer/Normal roles. These exact prefixed inverses preserve the earlier CNA recordings; the separate new CpG recording shows the current labels directly.

Default: 100 kb for QDNAseq.

Including normal/control samples selects the ONT solid-biopsy QDNAseq workflow.

View all study contexts and when to use them (opens in a new tab)

Uses the included evidence catalog. No publication searches or language-model downloads.

ONT methylation with Modkit

Dorado calls modified bases from POD5, or reuses MM/ML calls in your BAMs. Modkit extracts CpG methylation. Select Sturgeon for CNS tumours or MARLIN for leukemias.

Assign samples to a CpG classifier

Choose from the specimen diagnosis: MARLIN for leukemia research or Sturgeon for CNS-tumor research. Drag cards or use their dropdowns. Only the classifier group selected below is saved and run; the other group is not queued. Use a separate project for each classifier, keeping the completed ONT project unchanged.

Sturgeon · CNS

Modkit and Sturgeon use CPU. GPU can accelerate POD5 basecalling and MARLIN inference. FASTQs alone do not contain methylation calls.

Or select installed tools and model files below. Blank tool fields use your command search path where supported. Models are required here or in the YAML. Setup records checksums automatically.
